pages.heading:
HAWTHORNE & MERCER
Attorneys at Law · Bellweather, Ore.
pages.text:
Per the instructions of the late Mr. Arthur Vale:

The front key is enclosed. The electricity is unreliable; a lamp has been provided.

The terms of the bequest run from your arrival until midnight on the seventh day. We are not permitted to assist you further.

— T. Mercer, for the Executors
